articles.headline: Thomas Tuchel jokes U.S. President Trump could lift Jarell Quansah red card ban
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel has questioned the process which led to Folarin Balogun's suspension being lifted and joked Harry Kane could ask Donald Trump to help overturn Jarell Quansah's red card against Mexico.
